bug_fixes.description: TC-SH02-01 initially failed. The auth:session-expired handler called setSession(null) then navigate('/login?reason=session-expired'). ProtectedRoute re-rendered with isAuthenticated=false while the React Router location had not yet updated, firing a Navigate to /login (no query params) that overwrote the reason param. Fix: replaced navigate() with window.location.replace('/login?reason=session-expired') which is a synchronous hard navigation that completes before any React render cycle can interfere.
